scenario: Floa shared workspace tab strip at compact and standard widths
runtime: Google Chrome headless with CDP viewport override and actual Floa design tokens/style.css
harness: Static shell containing representative website tabs, the four workspace buttons, and a placeholder content surface
changes: Compact utility workspace buttons now use four equal grid columns so all labels fit without horizontal clipping.
Workspace strip rerendering restores keyboard focus to the same workspace or website tab after state updates.
The in-app Control+Tab and reverse shortcut cycle browser website tabs and all utility workspaces in a single loop; global equivalents are available and configurable in Settings.

The in-app next/previous defaults now use Control+Tab and Control+Shift+Tab, with a settings-recorder mapping that keeps macOS Control distinct from Command; previous built-in defaults migrate while custom assignments remain.
limitations: The shell uses static representative tab content; Electron WebContentsView switching, state persistence, and native OS shortcut delivery are not covered by these screenshots.
The screenshots verify tab-strip layout only; the placeholder content is not a utility workspace rendering.
Keyboard focus behavior used mocked IPC; native Electron key delivery and global OS shortcut registration were not exercised.
